about: The interface words (ui.*), the NPCs' roles (npc.<id>.role), the checklists' titles (objective.<id>.title) and the other objectives' lines (objective.<id>.hud).

strings.ui.retry: Not quite. Try once more, or press H for help.
strings.ui.helpDefault: Listen to the guide again, then say it as shown on the card. You can press K to skip this step.
strings.ui.objectiveComplete: Session complete: your fire is lit
strings.ui.spareTorch: A spare torch is in your bag. Take it up the trail and light your own fire.
strings.ui.sessionCompleteLine: Very good! Now you have a fire.
strings.ui.summaryPractiseNone: Next time, practise: nothing is flagged from this session
strings.ui.summaryReplay: Replay a lesson: press J for the book, choose a finished lesson, press Practise again, then talk to its guide.
strings.ui.handOverAsk: {npc} asks what you have. Hand it over in Spanish: say what you give, “Aquí tienes…” and the goods. Ayuda shows how.
strings.ui.handOverRetry: Not quite. Say what you hand over: “{spanish}”
strings.ui.handOverWrongGoods: That is not what {npc} asked for. Say: “{spanish}”
strings.ui.handOverTaken: {npc} takes the goods anyway. Next time, try: “{spanish}”
strings.ui.warmupOffer.one: A phrase from last time is ready for a quick warm-up. Not a test: skip it any time.
strings.ui.warmupOffer.other: {count} phrases from last time are ready for a quick warm-up. Not a test: skip it any time.
strings.ui.warmupAsk: {npc:guide} asks about something from before. Say your answer. H helps, K skips this one.
strings.ui.reviewNowHud: Review now: talk to {npc} to start the warm-up
strings.ui.dialogueKeyHints: Enter: send   Tab or Esc: buttons, then hold {key:listen} or {key:listenAlt}: speak   Alt+vowel: á é í ó ú   Alt+N: ñ   Alt+/: ¿   Alt+1: ¡
strings.ui.dialogueKeyHintsShort: Enter: send   Tab or Esc: buttons   Alt+vowel: á é í ó ú   Alt+N: ñ   Alt+/: ¿   Alt+1: ¡
strings.ui.dialogueButtonHints: Hold {key:listen} or {key:listenAlt}: speak   Esc: cancel or close
strings.ui.dialogueSpeechOffButtonHints: Speech off: type your answer (W or Tab)   Esc: close
strings.ui.dialogueSpeechOffKeyHints: Speech off: type your answer   Enter: send   Tab or Esc: buttons   Alt+vowel: á é í ó ú   Alt+N: ñ   Alt+/: ¿   Alt+1: ¡
strings.ui.coachOffPrompt: The NPC understood, but that is not what was asked. Answer the question to practise it.
strings.ui.controlsTextSize: Change the size of the text: 100, 125 or 150 percent. It is kept in the save.
strings.ui.controlsEffects: Turn the screen effects of hunger, thirst, tiredness and weakness on or off. The icons and the lines stay. It is kept in the save.
strings.ui.controlsSettings: Open the settings: how fast hunger, thirst and tiredness grow (the drive rate), the screen effects, relaxed needs, and the underwater blur. They are kept in the save.
strings.ui.settingsHint: Up/Down: choose. Left/Right or -/+: change. Esc: close.
strings.ui.stationHints: 1 to 9: hold   0: empty hand   Tab: next target   Enter: use   Page Up/Down: page   H: help   R: repeat   S: slower   V or Space: talk   W: type   Esc: leave
strings.ui.stationNothingHeld: Nothing held: press 1 to 9, or 0 for the empty hand.
strings.ui.stationWrongVerb: The right thing, but not that verb.
strings.ui.stationOutOfOrder: “Todavía no.” Not yet: that comes later.
strings.ui.stationBagFull: Your bag is full. Make room, then press Enter.
strings.ui.stationMissing: Gone from your bag: {nouns}. Do that step again.
strings.ui.stationNotEnough: Not enough in your bag for the bake at once. Nothing was used.
strings.ui.stationTalkListening: Listening... let go of the key to send.
strings.ui.saveLater: Wait a moment, then press {key:save} again.
strings.ui.inventoryHintsShort: {key:inventory} or Esc: close   1 to 0 or wheel: choose   click: mine, place
strings.ui.inventoryHints: {key:inventory} or Esc: close   1 to 0 or wheel: choose   left click: mine   right click: place
strings.ui.craftingHints: {key:crafting} or Esc: close   click a row: make
strings.ui.bookHints: {key:book} or Esc: close the book   Tab, Left, Right or click: turn the page   wheel: scroll   Shift+Up/Down: right page
strings.ui.bookHintsShort: {key:book} or Esc: close   Tab or click: turn page   wheel: scroll
strings.ui.bookLines: lines {from} to {to} of {count}   wheel, Page Up, Page Down
strings.ui.bookNoVerbs: No verbs yet. Use a verb in a sentence and it comes here.
strings.ui.bookChooseVerb: Choose a verb on the left page.
strings.ui.bookVerbKey: Highlighted: said (x = times). Plain: taught. Dash: not yet.
strings.ui.phraseCounts: with help {supported}   without help {unaided}   choices {choices}   don't know {dontKnow}   other situation {transfer}
strings.ui.bookLessonCounts: help used: {help}   I don't know: {dontKnow}   repeats asked: {repeats}   turns: {turns}
strings.ui.bookReviewDue.one: 1 phrase is ready for a warm-up with {npc:guide}
strings.ui.bookReviewDue.other: {count} phrases are ready for a warm-up with {npc:guide}
strings.ui.reportTitle: Report a bug or a feature request
strings.ui.reportHintsFirst: Ctrl+Enter: save report   Esc: cancel   Tab: Bug / Feature request   Enter: new line
strings.ui.reportHintsSecond: Alt+vowel: á é í ó ú   Alt+N: ñ   Alt+/: ¿   Alt+1: ¡
strings.ui.reportPlaceholder: Describe what happened, or what you would like. Spanish is fine too.
strings.ui.reportBlank: Write what you saw or wanted first, then save.
strings.ui.checkComprehensionHint: The line plays once (R hears it again). Press 1, 2 or 3 for the meaning.
strings.ui.checkProductionPreface: Say it in Spanish, the way you would to the person in this situation.
strings.ui.checkProductionHint: Hold {key:listen} and speak, or W to type. N: I don't know (no sé). Enter sends what you typed.
strings.ui.checkInLog: The answers are in the session log.
strings.ui.checkEnd: Esc: end the check (the rest is skipped)
strings.ui.checkVoiceOff: The voice is not available: type your answer (W).
strings.ui.micPassed: Got it, I can hear you.
strings.ui.micFailed: I didn't catch that. Try again?
strings.ui.replayHud: Practise again: talk to {npc} to start “{title}”
strings.ui.foodKept: You are not hungry. You keep the food.
strings.ui.plantedBush: You plant the berry. It bears fruit after a night.
strings.ui.plantFar: Plant it nearer the camp's fire.
strings.ui.plantFull: The camp has all the bushes it has room for.
strings.ui.diedHunger: You fainted from hunger and woke by your fire. Your things wait where you fell.
strings.ui.diedThirst: You fainted from thirst and woke by your fire. Your things wait where you fell.
strings.ui.chestRest: Your bag is full. The rest stays in the chest.
strings.ui.faintedHunger: You fainted from hunger and woke by your fire. Your bag is with you.
strings.ui.faintedThirst: You fainted from thirst and woke by your fire. Your bag is with you.
strings.ui.diedDrowned: You ran out of air. Swim up to breathe next time. You woke by your fire; your things wait where you fell.
strings.ui.faintedDrowned: You ran out of air. Swim up to breathe next time. You woke by your fire; your bag is with you.
strings.ui.playtestThanks: Thank you for playing. Your answers are in the session log.
strings.ui.playtestRecallThanks: Thank you. Your answers are in the session log.
strings.ui.speechUnavailable: Speech is not available: type your answer.
strings.ui.turnNotChecked: I couldn't check that line. Try again.
strings.ui.sleepHud: Session complete: sleep at your fire to start session {session}
strings.ui.reviewNothingDue: Nothing to review yet: carry on
strings.ui.sleepCard: {key:sleep}: sleep until morning and start session {session}
strings.ui.bookLessonsAllDone: Every lesson of the village is done, all {count}: the series ends here. Practise any of them again with its button below.
strings.objective.camp.title: camp
strings.objective.meet-guide.hud: Go down the trail and find the guide
strings.objective.light-fire.hud: Go back up the trail and light your own fire
strings.objective.fruit-for-mar.hud: Bring {npc:fisher} three fruits from the bushes at {npc:guide}'s camp
strings.objective.oven-wood.hud: Bring {npc:baker} five wood (madera) for her oven at the bakery
strings.objective.axe-handle.hud: Bring {npc:smith} two wood (madera) and two coins for an axe at the smithy
strings.objective.water-for-plants.hud: Bring {npc:farmer} a bottle of water (agua) for his plants at the field
